Interpretation guardrails

  • Periodicity is measured by folding |x[n]−x[n−1]| modulo each candidate period (USB 1 ms frames and multiples, and powers of two). A test is flagged only for a sharp single-phase excess (robust z ≥ 10, ≥ 1.25× the median phase, sharpness ≥ 1.2); broad frame-rate modulation of loud processed speech is reported but not flagged. Tone, chirp and transient-train sections are excluded on playback captures because their own periods divide the candidate periods.
  • A concentration at sample index modulo 512 is an observed capture periodicity, not proof of the firmware's internal block size. The host capture path control records the same device stream through FFmpeg/AVFoundation at the same time: bit-exact 512-frame blocks with whole blocks missing mean the discontinuities are created on the host, not in the XVF3800 stream.
  • Raw/pre-SHF controls help localize the point at which an artifact appears; the native-16-kHz control distinguishes a 48-kHz-path-specific failure from a general microphone/capture failure.
  • Raw jump counts above a fixed threshold depend on level, AGC and sample rate (16 kHz captures have larger adjacent-sample steps for the same audio) and are kept for reference only.
  • Audio is played by an independent host output; the XVF far-end/AEC playback path is intentionally not used.
